title: Men's Christian – Short Grace. Hot Food. Hoodie

seo.title: Funny Christian Hoodie for Men: Short Grace. Hot Food.
seo.description: A funny Christian hoodie for men: a dad, two kids and a steaming meatloaf, SHORT GRACE. HOT FOOD. Printed to order, free US shipping on $45+.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

This funny Christian hoodie is for the man who has prayed the shortest grace of his life at the church potluck while the casserole steams in front of him.

A dad in an orange plaid shirt and two kids bow their heads with hands folded over a table set with a steaming meatloaf, a pitcher and a basket of rolls. SHORT GRACE. runs above in heavy dark brown serif letters and HOT FOOD. below.

Pull it on for Sunday dinners, fellowship hall potlucks and every Thanksgiving table where the prayer needs to be quick. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed to order.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Sand, Sport Grey
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

What colors does it come in?
The Men's Christian Short Grace. Hot Food. hoodie comes in Sand and Sport Grey. The brown lettering and the warm plaid, orange and mustard art read clearly on both, a choice from Graphic Tees Co. so every word stays easy to read from across the room.

Is it a good gift for a church-going dad?
Yes. The Men's Christian Short Grace. Hot Food. hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. gives a dad, a deacon or a pastor a joke every potluck table understands, in an 8 oz 50/50 fleece that is warm for Sunday mornings. Order by about December 8 for Christmas delivery with free US shipping over $45.

How does the Short Grace. Hot Food. hoodie fit?
The Graphic Tees Co. Short Grace. Hot Food. hoodie is a classic unisex pullover cut in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one size for a roomier fit over a flannel or a Sunday dress shirt.

How do I care for it?
Machine wash this Graphic Tees Co. hoodie cold, inside out, with similar colors, then tumble dry low. The 8 oz 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece is pre-shrunk, and washing inside out keeps the printed brown lettering and the table scene looking sharp for years of potlucks.

Where does the print sit?
The Short Grace. Hot Food. print sits across the chest above the front pouch pocket, with SHORT GRACE. over the praying family and HOT FOOD. beneath, so both lines read from across a fellowship hall. The hood is double-lined with a matching drawcord for cold church parking lots.
